0.long_answer: Polydactyly is the term for the birth defect that results in extra fingers or toes, with the hands being more commonly affected than the feet. It is associated with at least 39 different genetic mutations and can present as an isolated condition or alongside other congenital anomalies. In some cases, the extra digits may be surgically removed if they affect functionality or aesthetics. Notably, the actress Gemma Christina Arterton was born with this condition and had her additional digits removed after birth.
